headline: Design Industry Bankruptcies Hit 14-Year High; In-House Generative AI Adoption Also Seen as a Factor
summary: Tokyo Shoko Research reported 40 design-industry bankruptcies in January to June 2026, about 2.7 times the 15 a year earlier. It is the highest first-half count in 14 years.
why: Tokyo Shoko Research is a major Japanese credit research firm that tracks corporate bankruptcies. Rising insolvencies in a sector can signal pressure from costs and shifting demand.
